output.final_sentiment_quote: Yeah for sure. I think I feel a lot less panicked than I did an hour ago. At least now I know what the word even means and that my heart isn't broken. Thank you, seriously.

pushbacks.quote: And honestly with long COVID every time I push myself I crash for days after. So I'm scared of that one.
pushbacks.reason: The reply acknowledges the risk of post-exertional malaise and shifts from general exercise advice to pacing, very gentle activity, and guidance from a clinician familiar with both conditions.
